newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Eltin says WMC deal worth A$190 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Eltin says WMC deal worth A$190 mln.

text.p: Mining contractor Eltin Ltd said on Tuesday that two significant contracts awarded to it by WMC Ltd were worth about A$190 million over 38 months.
"The new WMC contracts and the expanded works at Jundee have resulted in Eltin's work in hand reaching A$820 million," Eltin said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
"The Eltin group now has sufficient work in hand to exceed last year's contracting revenue of A$418 million," the company said.
The WMC contracts are for underground mining at the Long/Victor nickel complex and the Junction gold mine at Kambalda, Western Australia.
Eltin said the two contracts would commence before the end of October and would continue until the end of 1999.
The contracts are expected to generate revenue of A$40 million during 1996/97, Eltin said.
"The award of the underground contracts will see Eltin's underground operations revenue increase from its current annual level of A$115 million to an estimated A$140 million," it said.
